review_notes: I read the whole file and checked the definitions it introduces (InitProp, initIdeal, towerSubmodule) against Mathlib. I found no competing concept that Mathlib already has. The grep over Mathlib/RingTheory/Flat and the wider Mathlib tree found no existing lemma that a directed union of flat submodules is flat. It also found nothing on flatness of direct limits. towerSubmodule is a specific restriction of scalars of a subring to a smaller subring in a tower, and I found no Mathlib definition with the same meaning. The initial-ideal construction, InitProp and initIdeal, is bespoke to this proof. isHomogeneous_map duplicates Mathlib's MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.map, but that is only a duplicated theorem, which the rubric excludes. The graded-component lemmas are also theorem-level and excluded. I am fairly confident there are no concept-level duplicates, though I did not exhaustively search every Mathlib file.
